Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm ba'k gu Gador bɨɨx ka'm tas buusñi gu ñi'ook na ba'.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' gu oidha' gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Kâm oi'ñka' va'k.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon jix bɨɨx duu gu kavɨk gu Seir gu Pelatiia gu Neariias gu Repaiias gu Ussiel gu ma'nkam gu Isi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix daa jix duñia' gu Amalek jix daa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel na gu' ka't maa'nkam mar gu' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhim gu taat jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu mar gu Israeel; gio ba' cham ka't jix duñia' maa'nkam mar.
Na gu' na gu' gu Judaa ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Josee; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pallu gu Esroon gu Karmi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Joel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Gog gu mar gu Simi gu mar.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ma'nkam ko'kmarak chiñia' gu Jeiel gu Sakâriias.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' oo'm maakobh jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix buus.
Jano' ba' chooto'n bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Agarenos gu Jetur gu Napis gu Nodab.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x jix ai mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x kakneer gook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Na gu' ia'rɨ mui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix daa gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees jix daa gu oidha' dɨr gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Baal-ermoon gu Senir gu kavɨk gu ermoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix bɨɨx duu ɨɨbhidham gu vaak tattat; gio ba' gu Eper gu Isi gu Eliel gu Asriel gu Jeremiiyas gu Odabia gu Jadiel gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu vaak tattat.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu oidha' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Pul gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Tiglat-pilneser gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios bhaan gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu alad gu abor gu Ara gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gosaan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Amram gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Amram; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu Moisees gu Mariam; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; jano' ba' gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar.
Jano' ba' gu Eleasar jix mar gu Pinees jix mar gu Abisua.
Jano' ba' gu Abisua jix mar gu Bukki jix mar gu Ussi.
Jano' ba' gu Ussi jix mar gu Seraiias jix mar gu Meraiot.
Jano' ba' gu Meraiot jix mar gu Amariias jix mar gu Akîtob.
Jano' ba' gu Akîtob jix mar gu Sadok jix mar gu Akîmaas.
Jano' ba' gu Akîmaas jix mar gu Asariias jix mar gu Joanan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Joanan jix mar gu Asariias jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu Salomoon gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Asariias jix mar gu Amariias jix mar gu Akîtob.
Jano' ba' gu Akîtob jix mar gu Sadok jix mar gu Sallum.
Jano' ba' gu Sallum jix mar gu ilkiias tu' gu ilkiias jix mar gu Asariias.
Jano' ba' gu Asariias jix mar gu Seraiia jix mar gu Josadek.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Josadek ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu Libni gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Amram gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebii bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Joat gu mar gu Simma gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Iddo gu mar gu Sera gu mar gu Jeotrai gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Aminadab gu mar gu Koree gu mar gu Asir gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Elkana gu mar gu Abiasap gu mar gu Asir gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Taat gu mar gu Uriel gu mar gu Ussia gu mar gu Sauul gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elkana; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akîmot gu Elkana.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elkana; gio ba' gu Sopai gu mar gu Naat gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Eliab gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu Elkana gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Samueel; gio ba' maa'nkam mar gu Basni gu Abiiyas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Libni gu mar gu Simi gu mar gu Ussa gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Sima gu mar gu aggiia gu mar gu Assiia gu mar.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu Dabii jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix duñia' jɨɨpi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan vaak zel vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut xoi'kam bɨɨx ka'm gu Salomoon gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem; gio ba' mi' dhɨr bhaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu emaan gu mar gu Joel gu mar gu Samueel.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Elkana gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu Eliel gu mar gu Toa.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Sup gu mar gu Elkana gu mar gu Maat gu mar gu Amasai.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Elkana gu mar gu Joel gu mar gu Asariias gu mar gu Soponiias.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Taat gu mar gu Asir gu mar gu Abiasap gu mar gu Kore.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Isar gu mar gu Koat gu mar gu Lebii gu mar gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' xibhɨk gu Asap ka't gu novɨ tu jiim; gio ba' gu Asap gu mar gu Berakîas gu mar gu Sima.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Mikâel gu mar gu Baasiias gu mar gu Malkîas.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Atanai gu mar gu Sera gu mar gu Adaia.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Etaan gu mar gu Simma gu mar gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Jaat gu mar gu Gersoon gu mar gu Lebii.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ja'tkam mi'p gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim gu Etaan gu mar gu Kîsi gu mar gu Abdi gu mar gu Maluk.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu asabiias gu mar gu Amasiias gu mar gu ilkiias.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Amasai gu mar gu Bani gu mar gu Semer.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Maali gu mar gu Musi gu mar gu Merari gu mar gu Lebii.

Gu' gu' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx tu duukam pai' na ba' bhaan gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Eleasar gu mar gu Pinees gu mar gu Abisua gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Bukki gu mar gu Ussi gu mar gu Seraiias gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Meraiot gu mar gu Amariias gu mar gu Akîtob gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Sadok gu mar gu Akîmaas gu mar.
Na gu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Koatitas na gu' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu ebroon gu oidha' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham taañpu' jix maa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix maa jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim gu ebroon gu Libna bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu Asaan bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-semes bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu Geba bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Alemet bɨɨx gu Anatot bɨɨx; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix bɨɨx duu jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen bopxi'ñ gu Gad bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon jix maa jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Lebitas jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix maa jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx bopxi'ñ gu Epraim.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon jix maa ja'tkam vaak ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Golan gu Basaan bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Astarot bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr gu Kedes bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dobrat bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo tas buusñi gu Jordaan jix maa bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Beser oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jasa bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Kêdemot bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mepaat bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu Ramot gu Galaad bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Maanaim bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu esboon bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jaker bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr maakobh; gio ba' gu Tola gu Puua gu Jabsub gu Simroon.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Tola; gio ba' gu Ussi gu Repaiias gu Jeriel gu Jamai gu Jibsam gu Samueel ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat; mi' dhɨr gu Tola jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu Dabii jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu Issakâr bɨx jix duñia' jix bhai'x kɨɨv ja'tkam vaak gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bekêr; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joas gu Elieser gu Elioenai gu Omri gu Jerimot gu Abiiyas gu Anatot gu Alemet; mi' dhɨr bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Bekêr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam jix duñia' ɨɨbhidham gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Jediael ka't gu Bilaan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bilaan; mi' dhɨr gu Jebuus gu Benjamiin gu Aod gu Kênaana gu Setaan gu Tarsis gu Aisaar.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Jediael ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu Suppim gu uppim jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu ir; gio ba' gu usim gu mar gu Aer.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii; gio ba' gu Jaoel gu Guni gu Jeser gu Sallum gu ma'nkam gu Bila.

Jano' ba' jix duu mar u'vɨ ka't gu Seera gu Bet-oron gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ussen-seera.
Jano' ba' gu mar dhi' gu Beriia ka't gu Repa gu Resep gu Tela gu mar gu Taaan gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Laadaan gu mar gu Ammiud gu mar gu Elisama gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Nun gu mar gu Josuee gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar ba'bhak ka't gu Bet-el bɨɨx taañpu'; gio ba' bhaan tas buusñi gu Naaraan baasɨ'n tas gei'ñ gu Geser taañpu'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sikêm bɨɨx taañpu' bɨɨx ka'm gu Asa taañpu'.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu Bet-seaan bɨɨx taañpu' gu Tanak bɨɨx taañpu' gu Megiddo bɨɨx taañpu' gu Dor bɨɨx taañpu'; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix daa gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu mar gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aser; gio ba' gu Imna gu Isua gu Isui gu Beriia gu ja'tkam gu Sera.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Beriia; gio ba' gu eber gu Makîel ka't gu taat gu Birsabit.
Jano' ba' gu eber jix mar gu Japlet gu Semer gu otam gu Sua gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Japlet; gio ba' gu Pasak gu Bimal gu Asbat; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Japlet.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Semer; gio ba' gu Ai gu Roega gu Jeubba gu Aram.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu elem xibhɨk; gio ba' gu Sopa gu Imna gu Selles gu Amal.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sopa; gio ba' gu Sua gu arnaper gu Sual gu Beri gu Imra.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jeter; gio ba' gu Jepone gu Pispa gu Ara.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ulla; gio ba' gu Ara gu aniel gu Resia.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Aser ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhidham chiñia'; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jɨɨ'ñdhidha' ka't jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin jix mar gu Bela maa'nkam mar gu Asbel gook gu Ara vaik.
Jano' ba' gu Noa maakobh gu Rapa jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bela jix bɨɨx duu gu Addar gu Gera gu Abiud.
Jano' ba' gu Abisua gu Naamaan gu Aoa.
Jano' ba' gu Gera gu Sepupim gu uram.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Eud dhi' ja'tkam ɨɨbhidham tattat jix daa gu Gabaa jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Manaat.
Jano' ba' maachim; gio ba' gu Naamaan gu Akîas gu Gera; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix mar gu Ussa gu Aiud.
Jano' ba' gu Saaraim jix mar gu ma'nkam oidha' gɨ' gu Moab mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu usim gu Baara jix duñia' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix mar gu Kôdes gu u'vɨ gu Jobab gu Sibias gu Mesa gu Malkâm.
Jano' ba' gu Jeus gu Sokîas gu Mirma; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Gu' gu' gu usim jix mar gu Abitob gu Elpaal.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elpaal; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Misam gu Semeb pai'x gu Ono gu Lot bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Beriias gio gu Sema jix bɨɨx duu ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Ajaloon gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Gat.
Jano' ba' gu Aiio gu Sasak gu Jeremot.
Jano' ba' gu Sebadiias gu Arad gu eder.
Jano' ba' gu Mikâel gu Ispa gu Joa gu ma'nkam gu Beriias.
Jano' ba' gu Sebadiias gu Mesullam gu iskî gu eber.
Jano' ba' gu Ismari gu Islia gu Jobab gu ma'nkam gu Elpaal.
Jano' ba' gu Jakim gu Sikri gu Sabdi.
Jano' ba' gu Elioenai gu Silitai gu Eliel.
Jano' ba' gu Adaiias gu Baraiias gu Simrat gu ma'nkam gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu Ispaan gu eber gu Eliel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sikri gu anaan.
Jano' ba' gu ananiia gu Belam gu Anatotiias.
Jano' ba' gu Ipdaiias gu Peniel gu ma'nkam gu Sasak.
Jano' ba' gu Samseri gu Seariias gu Ataliia.
Jano' ba' gu Jaarsiias gu Eliiyas gu Sikri gu ma'nkam gu Jeroam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix daa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Gabaoon jix daa gu Abiga-baoon gu u'vɨ jup tɨɨt gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' gu mar maa'nkam mar gu Abdoon gu Sur gu Kîs gu Baal gu Nadab.
Jano' ba' gu Gedor gu Aiie gu Sekêr.
Jano' ba' gu Miklot jix mar gu Simea; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gio jix daa bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Ner jix mar gu Kis jix mar gu Sauul jix mar gu Jonataan gu Malkî-suua gu Abinadab gu Esbaal.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Jonataan ka't gu Merib-baal jix mar gu Mikâ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Mikâ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Melek gu Taarea gu Aas.
Jano' ba' gu Aas jix mar gu Joadda; gio ba' gu Joadda jix mar gu Elemet gu Asmabet gu Simri; mi' dhɨr gu Simri jix mar gu Mosa.
Jano' ba' gu Mosa jix mar gu Bina gu mar ka't gu Rapa gu mar ka't gu Elasa gu mar ka't gu Asel.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asel jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Asrikam gu Bokru gu Ismael gu Seariias gu Obadiias gu anaan; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Asel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Esek xibhɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maa'nkam mar gu Jeus gook gu Elipelet vaik.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Ulam gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chooto'n mui'x gu ma'nkam chamaam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu Kontado bɨx gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Judaa jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Babiloonia uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' dharka' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n baap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh jix bɨɨx duu gu Israeel na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu Netineos.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Jerusalem gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Amiud gu mar gu Omri gu mar gu Imrai gu mar gu Bani gu ma'nkam gu Pares gu mar gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Siloni gu Asaiias maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sara gu Jeuel gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu Sallu gu mar gu Mesullam gu mar gu Odabiia gu mar gu Asenua.
Jano' ba' gu Ibniias gu mar gu Jeroam gu Ela gu mar gu Ussi gu mar gu Mikri; gio ba' gu Mesullam gu mar gu Sepatiias gu mar gu Reuel gu mar gu Ibniias.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu mambhɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu ɨɨbhidham ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu Jedaiia gu Joiarib gu Joakîm.
Jano' ba' gu Asariias gu mar gu ilkiias gu mar gu Mesullam gu mar gu Sadok gu mar gu Meraiot gu mar gu Akîtob gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Adaiias gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu Pasur gu mar gu Makîas; gio ba' gu Masai gu mar gu Adiel gu mar gu Jasera gu mar gu Mesullam gu mar gu Mesillemit gu mar gu Immer.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ɨɨbhidham gu vaak tattat jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu Semeiias gu mar gu assub gu mar gu Asrikam gu mar gu asabiias gu ma'nkam gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu Bakbakkar gu eres gu Galal gu Mattaniia gu mar gu Mikâs gu mar gu Sikri gu mar gu Asap.
Jano' ba' gu Obadiias gu mar gu Semeiias gu mar gu Galal gu mar gu Idutum; gio ba' gu Berakîas gu mar gu Asa gu mar gu Elkana jix daa taañpu' gu Netopati.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Sallum gu Akkub gu Talmon gu Aiman gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Sallum ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Lebii jix duñia' dhi' ja'tkam ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' gu Sallum gu mar gu Kore gu mar gu Abiasat gu mar gu Kora gu ja'tkam gu Koraitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu taat chooto'n gu ñi'ook nukadham kiki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' tattat jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Jawatan Dios nuuka'n ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar ka't va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Sakariias gu mar gu Meselemia ka't gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Na pai' dhuuk bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' nuuka'n kiki'ñgob jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu gu Dabii gu Samueel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh jɨbɨɨlh tas buusñi tas gei'ñ saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam mi'p taañpu' aajidha' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Na gu' na gu' maakobh gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas mi'p ko'kmarak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ko'kmarak gu ñi'ook bhi'spio'kai sɨlhkam.
Jano' ba' dhɨt dhi' ja'tkam ko'kmarak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ko'kmarak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx xidhuu suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' kubhion.
Jano' ba' dhɨt gu ma'nkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Matatiias maa'n gu Lebitas maa'nkam mar gu Sallum gu Koraita ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x.

Jano' ba' gu Asel jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu Asrikam gu Bokru gu Ismael gu Seraiia gu Obadiias gu anaan; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Asel.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu Israelitas ia'rɨ gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos bhiadat gu Sauul gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos gu Jonataan gu Abinadab gu Malkîsua gu ma'nkam gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Sauul ka't.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul kutun kavɨk; na gu' jix buusñi gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx na gu' cham dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu'; na gu' gu' kutun kavɨk cham na gu' ga'ra' ɨɨbhi'ñ; jano' ba' gu Sauul jix bhɨɨ gu kuchii bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p kutun kavɨk jix ñi' gu Sauul jix koi gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu Israeel oi'ñka' gu ñi'ook jix daa jix duñia' gu Sauul gu ma'nkam jix duñia' koko'kam gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh jiboi'ññor; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos jix daa.
Jano' ba' ka't bai'ñpu' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koko'kam gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu ma'nkam gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' a'lhiok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ bɨx gu oidha' gu Pilisteos na ba' jum duu duiñxim gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix búup bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu Sauul gu chuukug gu ma'nkam aichdhak gu Jabes; gio ba' o'oo bɨtaa'n gu Jabes kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ bɨɨx jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham nukadham; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jum daa'ñ gu Dabii gu ebroon bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch gu'ch o'o gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k jano' gu Sauul tu' jix buusñi gu Israeel; gio ba' gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' ka' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu Israeel gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨɨtɨs bɨx daraa gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu Dabii bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu jiim gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Samueel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel gu Jerusalem gu Jebus; gio ba' ka't gu Jebuseo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jebus gui'p gu Dabii; gio ba' cham ba'k jix bhai'x; gu' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu kavɨk gu Sioon kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook; na maa'n gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo ka't mo'o gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia jix tɨ'ɨ maa'n ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix daa gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tɨɨt kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix duu kiicham xikoolh dɨr gu Millo bɨɨx ka'm mia'n; gio ba' gu Joab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu Dabii jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel na ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jix kavɨk gu Dabii jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Jasobam gu mar gu akmoni gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n u'u kavɨk jix duñia' bhaan vaik.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Eleasar gu mar gu Dodo gu Aoita ka't vaik jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' dhi' juruuñ bɨɨx gu Dabii gu Pasdammin kua' tɨtda:―Aañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos; gio ba' ka't gu oidha' gu ñi'ook kai' vaas gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jix gɨ' dodhia'.
Jano' ba' vaik gu ñi'ook jix dhaav jodai kavɨk gu Dabii jumpa'n gu Adullam kua' yooxi' gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu Rapaim.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't jano' ba' gu kavɨk ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos gu Bet-leem.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix duu jano' ba'; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i gu suudai' oidha' suudai' gu Bet-leem ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu suudai' oidha' suudai' gu Bet-leem ki'ñgob aichdhak gu Dabii; gu' cham i'i gu ñi'ook ja'aa gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'.

Jano' ba' cham jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dhi'; gio ba' ka't tu' i'i gu ɨ'ɨr dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix duñia' cham i'i; mi' dhɨr dhi' jix duu mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaik jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Abisai xibhɨk gu Joab ka't mo'o vaik gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n u'u kavɨk bhaan vaik naaka'n; gio ba' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' vaik ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gu' cham vaik dharka'.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiias gu mar gu Joiada gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kabseel; gio ba' gook gu Moab; mi' dhɨr gio jix dhaav tu' naaka'n maavɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jabook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkio gu chio'ñ jixchamaam dhi'; gio ba' gu Egipkio u'u kavɨk na ja'p; gu' jix dhaav bɨɨx gu Egipkio u'u kavɨk gu novɨ mu'aa bɨɨx u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu Benaiias gu mar gu Joiada ka't jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhat gu ñi'ook gu' cham vaik dharka'; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix kavɨk chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu Asael xibhɨk gu Joab gu Elkânan gu mar gu Dodo gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu Samot gu Arori gu elles gu Pelonita.
Jano' ba' gu Ira gu mar gu Akkes gu Tekoita gu Abieser gu Anatotita.
Jano' ba' gu Sibbekai gu usatita gu Ilai gu Aoita.
Jano' ba' gu Maarai gu Netopatita gu eled gu mar gu Baana gu Netopatita.
Jano' ba' gu Itai gu mar gu Ribai gu Gabaat gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Benaiias gu Piratita.
Jano' ba' gu urai gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gaas gu Abiel gu Arbatonita.
Jano' ba' gu Asmabet gu Baarumita gu Eliaba gu Saalbonita.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asem gu Gisonita gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sajee gu ararita.
Jano' ba' gu Aiam gu mar gu Sakâr gu Ararita gu Elipal gu mar gu Ur.
Jano' ba' gu eper gu Mekêratita gu Aiia gu Pelonita.
Jano' ba' gu esro gu Karmelita gu Naari gu mar gu Esbai.
Jano' ba' gu Joel xibhɨk gu Nataan gu Mibar gu mar gu Agrai.
Jano' ba' gu Selek gu Ammonita gu Naarai gu Berotita kutun kavɨk gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia.
Jano' ba' gu Ira gu Itreo gu Yared gu Itreo.
Jano' ba' gu Uriia gu eteo gu Sabad gu mar gu Ali.
Jano' ba' gu Adina gu mar gu Sisa gu Rubenita gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Rubenitas bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu anaan gu mar gu Maakâ gu Josapat gu Mitnita.
Jano' ba' gu Ussiias gu Astarotita gu Samma gu Jeiel gu ma'nkam gu otam gu Arorita.
Jano' ba' gu Jediael gu mar gu Simri gu Joa xibhɨk gu Tisaita.
Jano' ba' gu Eliel gu Maabii gu Jeribai gu Josabia gu ma'nkam gu Elnaam tu' gu Itma gu Moabita.
Jano' ba' gu Eliel gu Obed gu Jaasiel gu Mesobia.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs gu Dabii gu Siklag kua' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu Sauul gu mar gu Kis jix duñia' jix kavɨk bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh gu jodai bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Sauul gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Aieser mi' dhɨr gu Joas gu ma'nkam gu Semaa gu Gabaatita; gio ba' gu Jesiel gu Pelet gu ma'nkam gu Asmabet gu Beraka gu Jeuu gu Anatotita.
Jano' ba' gu Ismaiias gu Gabaonita jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jeremiiyas gu Jaasiel gu Joanaan gu Josabad gu Gederatita.
Jano' ba' gu Elusai gu Jeremot gu Bealiias gu Semariias gu Sepatiias gu arupita.
Jano' ba' gu Elkana tu' gu Isiias gu Asareel gu Joeser gu Jasobam gu Koree.
Jano' ba' gu Joela gu Sebadiias gu ma'nkam gu Jeroam gu Gedor.

Jano' ba' gio gu Gad jiboi'ññor gu Dabii kua' gu kavɨk oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx kutun kavɨk; gio ba' na ja'p chiiw gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Eser maa'n gu Obadiias gook gu Eliab vaik.
Jano' ba' gu Mismana maakobh gu Jeremiiyas jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu Attai xijumai gu Eliel kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu Joanaan jix bhai'x gu Elsabad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas gu ñi'ook gu Makbani gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ma'nkam gu Gad; gio ba' jix ali' ga'ra' gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ' mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan maa'n na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan; gio ba' tu' jix duu bɨx tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhɨt gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Judaa tɨɨtɨs gu Dabii gu kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix buus bham; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tɨbiap tu' na ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ ka't bɨɨx; gu' tu' na ba' gu noobh cham tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tattat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Amasai gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii bɨndak gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨndak bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx; na gu' gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' u'ua'tɨdham; gio ba' gu Dabii jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii dhɨt gu Manasees na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va bɨɨx gu Pilisteos bhaan gu Sauul cham; na gu' gu Pilisteos bham; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ɨɨbhidham gu Jawatan gu Sauul.
Na ba' bai'ñpu' gu Siklag gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Manasees gu Adnas gu Josabad gu Jediaiel gu Mikâel gu Josabad gu Eliuu gu Silletai chiñia' gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bhaan mii' dhɨr chu'p; na gu' bɨx jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix bɨɨx duu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Na gu' na gu' jano' ba' bɨx gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'ua'tɨdham gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ja'p ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ñi'ook mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨɨtɨs gu Dabii gu ebroon na ba' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Sauul jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk mambhɨɨx gɨ' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham kɨɨv jix bhai'x chamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii maakobh jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joiada gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon bɨɨx vaik jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Sadok biapma' jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gook gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ja'tkam gu Sauul vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook mui'x ko'kmarak baasɨ'n gu vaak gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk gu chio'ñ gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x jix bɨɨx duu na ba' gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook pui'm gu Israeel tu ñi'ook oi'ñchu' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Sabuloon mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham cham gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Neptalii jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kɨɨv jix bhai'x bɨɨx kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Aser gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook oo'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Rubenitas gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees chamaam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ebroon na ba' gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel mi'p na ba' gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Dabii vaik gu tanoolh jix bhai'x na gu' gu ja'tkam na ba'.

Jano' ba' gio jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu Issakâr gu Sabuloon gu Neptalii aichdhak gu takarui' buur jix ai gu vaakax; na gu' gu' suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu vaakax kakneer na gu' gu Israeel ka't bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu Dios gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bɨx oi'ñga'n gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx no'ch.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios no'ch na gu' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Sauul cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' xoi'kam bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Dabii bɨx gu Israeel dɨr gu Sior gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm baakɨi gu amat na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Kîriat-jearim.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel gu Baala gu Kîriat-jearim gu Judaa na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Abinadab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨɨk; gio ba' gu Ussa xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx gu Israeel gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx tu' na jix kavɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.
Na gu' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Kidoon gu Ussa gu novɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ba' jix xoi'kam na gu' gu vaakax.
Na gu' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Ussa tu' naaka'n na gu' ka't gu novɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix koi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu Dabii jix duñia' jix duu na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ussa; gio ba' jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Peeres-ussa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak kiicham gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu Geteo.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios juruuñ gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu vaak vaik masaa'n; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom bɨx tu'x ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gio gu u'vɨ gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Dabii gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Samua gu Sobab gu Nataan gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Ibar gu Elisua gu Elipelet.
Jano' ba' gu Noga gu Nepeg gu Japiias.
Jano' ba' gu Elisama gu Beel-iada gu Elipelet.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pilisteos gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' Xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' na ja'p gu Dabii jix kai jix buus bhaan.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Rapaim.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' bhaan gu Pilisteos kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu' kapbhai' gu noobh.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Baal-perasim naaka'n gu Dabii; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam obhɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ na ja'p gu suudai'; jano' ba' dhi' tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Baal-perasim.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos jix duu gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' jix ai vupui bhaan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jaja' jix duñia' jix buus; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Pilisteos dɨr gu Gabaoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Geser.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx mii' dhɨr oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios choo'n gu Dabii bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu vaak na ba' kiicham gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios vaak zel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Lebitas; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Dabii bɨx gu Israeel gu Jerusalem na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios pai' ka't.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gio gu Dabii gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu Uriel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam chamaam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu Asaiias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu Joel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam chamaam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elisapaan gu Semeiias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ebroon gu Eliel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel gu Aminadab gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam chamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Dabii gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu Uriel gu Asaiias gu Joel gu Semeiias gu Eliel gu Aminadab.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tattat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Lebitas jix bhaan gu ja'tkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel pai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios no'ch na gu' cham bhaan jir bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas jix bhaan na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebitas aichdhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu Lebitas gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu emaan gu mar gu Joel; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Asap gu mar gu Berekîas; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ja'tkam gu Etaan gu mar gu Kusaiias.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sakâriias gu Ben gu Jaasiel gu Semiramot gu Jeiel gu Unni gu Eliab gu Benaiias gu Maasiias gu Matitiias gu Elipeleu gu Mikniias gu Obed-edom gu Jeiel.
Jano' ba' gu emaan gu Asap gu Etaan jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar bɨɨx gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu Sakâriias gu Jaasiel gu Semiramot gu Jeiel gu Unni gu Eliab gu Maasiias gu Benaiias bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Alamot.
Jano' ba' gu Matitiias gu Elipeleu gu Mikniias gu Obed-edom gu Jeiel gu Asasiias alabaa'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daam.
Jano' ba' gu Kênaniias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Lebitas ka't na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' na gu' ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Berekîas gu Elkana jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Sebaniias gu Josapat gu Natanael gu Amasai gu Sakâriias gu Benaiias gu Elieser jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Obed-edom gu Jeiias jix duñia' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii daraa gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Lebitas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' kɨɨv gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨi'chu' gio bɨx gu Lebitas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Kênaniias ka't tɨkkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gio gu Dabii bhaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu Dabii gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul tɨɨgɨk gu ñi'ook jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix duñia'; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' aichdhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel gu Dabii ka't na ba'; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ maa'n gu takarui' gu chuukug suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Lebitas na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Asap maa'n gook mi' dhɨr gu Sakâriias gu Jeiel gu Semiramot gu Jeiel gu Matitiias gu Eliab gu Benaiias gu Obed-edom gu Jeiel bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Asap jix duñia' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiias gio gu Jaasiel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix maa gu Dabii gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Asap gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ja'tkam buimɨi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx kɨɨ'p.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim atooxkor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii tu' na ba' tas na jix gɨ' tu duukam gu' tu' jix maati' tu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu' naaka'n gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sima xibhɨk gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Rapa gu Gat ia'rɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Dabii tu duukam.
Gu' gu' gu Satanaas jix búup bhaan gu Israeel tu' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Joab chiñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel dɨr gu Beer-seba bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' na ba' tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook mui'kim; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan cham bɨx dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam gu Jawatan na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan dhi' ka't gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab; gio ba' jix buus gu Joab ka't bɨx gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem jix maa jix duñia' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ja'tkam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel jix duñia' gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'kim gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu Judaa jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii.
Na gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam cham jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas tu' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin na gu' gu Joab jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios tu' naaka'n gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bhaan dhi'; na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu duukam na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gad gu ñi'ook gu Dabii bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr vaik tu'x tu'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨndak.
Ba' jix aa' bai'ñpu' gu Gad gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik bhiogi'; gio ba' vaik masaa'n vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu kuchii tu'; mi' dhɨr vaik gu tanoolh gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oidha' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Gad; gio ba' dhi' jix gɨ' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr soi'ñ tu' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam mumua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' tu' gu noobh gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ia'rɨ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios nobii'ñ gu Jerusalem na ba' cham tu' duu; gu' kua' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ; jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan ka't gu Ornaan gu Jebuseo.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu vupui jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' ua'tulhdhidha' gu kuchii gu novɨ bhaan gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii daraa bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham bhai'; gu' dhi' kakneer jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jano' gu novɨ bhaan tu' bhaan gu vaak gu taat cham ka't gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gad tu ñi'ook gu Dabii jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Ornaan gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Gad ka't tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk gu Ornaan jix ñi' nobii'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh gu ma'nkam bɨɨx mi'p; mi' dhɨr gu Ornaan tiriik.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu Dabii gu Ornaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ñi' gu Dabii; gio ba' gamai' ka't o'lhia'n gu oidha' gu Dabii.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Ornaan; gio ba' gu Dame dhi' pai' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' u'uuk na ba' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Ornaan jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr gu vaakax na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu u'u tiriik na ba'; jano' ba' tu' bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu Ornaan; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai' u'uuk; na gu' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan cham tu'.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Dabii gu Ornaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu tai gu tɨkɨr jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios nobii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios ka't naak ka't gu Ornaan gu Jebuseo maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees ka't gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan mi'p jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu Gabaoon; na gu' gu' gu Dabii cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ka't kuiñcha gu kuchii nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios dhi' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix aa'ñdhix gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mi'p gu oidha' gu Israeel nɨi'ñchudat tɨ'ya' gu jodai na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii jix jai' jix kavɨk jodai na ba' kiki'ñgob na ba'; gio ba' jix jai' gu jodai' na jix uam cham gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk cham jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Sidonios gu Tirios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Salomoon gu mar gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' nɨidhat bɨx oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr jano' tu' bɨɨpɨ'm; jano' ba' gu Dabii va'k koi'm jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' suudai' u'va tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu' vaak na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr bhɨɨ'ñdham; na gu' cham gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' na gu' vaak na jix bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha' vupui bhaan tu'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar tu' ka't gu chio'ñ jɨɨpi'ñka' na gu' tu' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ; na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Salomoon; mi' dhɨr tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ jɨɨpi'ñka' bhaan gu Israeel gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar tu' jix duñia' gu taat; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bɨndak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' nukadham ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu duukam ñi'ook kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees na ba' gu Israeel; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix uam jodai cha'tmam jix toja jodai; na gu' cham juraa'n gu jodai' na jix uam tu' jix kavɨk jodai na gu' jix jai'; mi' dhɨr gu u'u gu jodai tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak mui'x tɨ'ya' bɨx gu chio'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai cham cham tu'x jai'ch jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; gio ba' bamii' tu duukam; na gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'ñdhix gu Dabii bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel u'ua'tɨdham gu Salomoon gu mar bham.

Na gu' cham bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix búup xidhuu gu Jawatan Dios na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh gu Salomoon gu mar gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook jiix; gio ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' ɨɨbhidham maa'n gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' suulhgia' maakob jix bhai'x na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh jix bhai'x; gio ba' maakobh jix bhai'x na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Dabii bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii jurtu'nka' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu Ladaan gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ladaan vaik; gio ba' gu Jeiel maa'n mi' dhɨr gu Setam gu Joel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simi vaik; gio ba' gu Selomit gu asiel gu Araan; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ladaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simi; gio ba' gu Jaat gu Sinat gu Jeus gu Beriias; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam maakobh jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu Jaat ka't maa'n gu Sinat gook; gu' gu Jeus gu Beriias cham jix mui' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Amram gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel maakobh.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Amram; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr gu Aaroon ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix bhaan tu'x gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas na ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Lebii.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Moisees jix bɨɨx duu gu Gersoon gu Elieser.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Gersoon ka't gu Sebuel maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Elieser ka't gu Reabiia maa'n; gio ba' gu Elieser cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Reabiia jix bɨɨx duu mui'x.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Isar ka't gu Selomit maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ebroon; gio ba' gu Jeriia maa'n gu Amariias gook gu Jaasiel vaik gu Jekamaan maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel; gio ba' gu Mikâ maa'n tu' gu Isiia gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Maali; jano' ba' gu Eleasar gu Kis.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Eleasar cham gu ma'nkam gu' jix duñia' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kis gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Musi; gio ba' gu Maali gu Eder gu Jerimot vaik.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat gu tɨɨgɨ' ɨɨbhidham duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jiix.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gio gu Lebitas cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx na ba'.
Na ba' jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu ñi'ook jiix.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu takarui' tɨkiix na ba' gu maa'nkar na ba' cham jabka' na ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh bɨx gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu xumai.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tas na jix bhaan jix duñia' duñia' ko'kmarak vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix nukadham xidhuu gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon chooto'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; mi' dhɨr gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar.
Gu' gu' gu Nadab gu Abiuu jix koko' va'k gu taat cham chooto'n gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar chooto'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sadok gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar gu Aimelek gu ma'nkam gu Itamar jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar jix bɨɨx duu bakia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ mui'x gu ma'nkam gu Itamar; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar ka't ɨɨbhidham; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Itamar tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar gu ma'nkam gu Itamar ka't chiñia' xidhuu chiñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Semeiias gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Natanael gu Lebitas ua'na vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' vupui bhaan gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aimelek gu mar gu Abiatar chiñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' ja'tkam vaak gu Eleasar gu Itamar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus gu Joiarib gookim gu Jedaiia.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu arim gu ñi'ook gu Seorim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Malkîas gu Miamim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kos gu Abiiyas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jesua gu ñi'ook gu Sekâniia.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliasib gu Jakim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Uppa gu Isebeab.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bilga gu Immer.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu esir gu Apses.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Petaiia gu esekiel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakim gu amul.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Delaiia gu Maasiia.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ba'k gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' jir bɨx bhai' gu Aaroon gu taat ka't jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Subael gu ma'nkam gu Amram; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Subael gu Jeediias.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Reabiia gu Isias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Isareos gu Selemot; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu Selemot gu Jat.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ebroon; gio ba' gu Jeria maa'n gook gu Amariias vaik gu Jaasiel maakobh gu Jekamaan.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Ussiel gu Mikâ; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu Mikâ gu Samir.
Jano' ba' xibhɨk gu Mikâ gu Isiia; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu Isiia gu Sakâriias.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu Jaasia gu Benno.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jaasia; gio ba' gu Benno gu Soam gu Sakûr tu' gu Ibri.
Jano' ba' gu Maali gu Eleasar cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Kis gu Jerameel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Musi; gio ba' gu Maeli gu Eder gu Jerimot; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Lebitas jurtu'nka' gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mamai'chɨk na ja'p gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu Sadok gu Aimelek chiñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tattat jix ali' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Asimismo gu Dabii chiñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asap gu emaan gu Jedutuun bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' ka't gu chichio'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asap; gio ba' gu Sakûr gu Josee gu Metaniias gu Asareela gu ma'nkam gu Asap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asap jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Jedutuun; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jedutuun gu Gedaliias gu Sesi gu Jesaiias gu asabiias gu Matitiias gu Simi; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu taat gu Jedutuun jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asareel bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu asabiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Subael bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Matitiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerimot bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ananiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu anani bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Malloti bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliata bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Otir bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Giddalti bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Maasiot bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Romamti-eser bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Koraitas; mi' dhɨr gu Meselemia gu mar gu Koree gu ma'nkam gu Asap.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Meselemia; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkam mar gu Jediael gook gu Sebadiias vaik gu Jatnael maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu Elam jixchamaam gu Joanam xijumai gu Elioenai kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Obed-edom; gio ba' gu Semeiias maa'nkam mar gu Josabad gook gu Joab vaik maakobh gu Sakâr jixchamaam gu Natanael.
Jano' ba' xijumai gu Anmiel kɨɨv gu Issakâr jix bhai'x gu Peulletai; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Obed-edom.
Jano' ba' gio gu Semeiias gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu gu Jawatan bhaan gu vaak tattat; na gu' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Semeiias; gio ba' gu Otni gu Rapael gu Obed gu Elsabad gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Eliuu gu Samakîas.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Obed-edom; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk na ba'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gook gu Obed-edom.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Meselemia gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu osa gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Simri gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't maa'nkam mar gu' gu taat jix dhaas na ba' jum duu mo'o; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gook gu ilkiias vaik gu Tebeliias maakobh gu Sakâriias; gio ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu osa gu ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mamai'chɨk jix ali' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu vaak tattat na ba' ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas buusñi gu Selemiia; gio ba' gu Sakâriias gu mar gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n mamai'chɨk; mi' dhɨr jix buus gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Obed-edom saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu vaak jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Suppim gu osa tas gei'ñ bɨɨx ki'ñgob gu Sallekêt gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tas buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tanoolh; gio ba' saagi'ñ maakobh gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu vaak jix duñia' gook.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas gei'ñ maakobh gu bhóogɨt gook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Koraitas gu ma'nkam gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu Akîas ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Ladaan gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu Ladaan chiñia' gu Ladaan jix bɨɨx duu gu Gersoon gu Jeieli.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jeieli gu Setaan gu Joel xibhɨk chooto'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Amramitas gu Isaritas gu ebronitas gu Ussielitas.
Jano' ba' gu Sebuel gu mar gu Gersoon gu mar gu Moisees ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk gu Elieser gu mar ka't gu Reabiia gu mar gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Joram gu mar gu Sikri ka't gu mar gu Selomit.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Selomit gu ja'tkam ko'kmarak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu'x ka't jix bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii chiñia' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu'x ka't jix bhaan gu Samueel gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu mar gu Kis gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia; gio ba' bɨx no'x ka't gu novɨ gu Selomit gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Isaritas gu Kenaniia gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel buimɨi mai'.

Jano' ba' gu ebronitas gu asabiias gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Israeel baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas gei'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu ebronitas gu Jeriias ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ebronitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' oi'ñga' oo'm gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix kavɨk gu jodai' na jix uam gu Jaser gu Galaad.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix duñia' gook jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhidham gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas bhaan ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees na ba' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' maachim chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bɨx jix buus bɨx masaa'n oi'ñga' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n ka't gu Jasobam gu mar gu Sabdiel; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Pares ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx maa'n.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook ka't gu Dodai gu Aoita; gio ba' gu Miklot ka't jix gɨ' gio ka't gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' vaik ka't gu Benaiias gu mar gu Joiada gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Benaiias ka't jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Amisabad gu mar.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' maakobh ka't gu Asael xibhɨk gu Joab mi' dhɨr gu Sebadiias gu mar; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jixchamaam ka't gu Sambut gu Isrita; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' xijumai na ba' xijumai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ira gu mar gu Ikkes gu Tekoa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv na ba' kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu elles gu Pelonita gu ma'nkam gu Epraim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x na ba' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Sibbekai gu usatita gu Sarai; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x na ba' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Abieser gu Anatotita gu Benjamitas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Maarai gu Netopatita gu Sarai; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ka't gu Benaiias gu Piratonita gu ma'nkam gu Epraim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu eldai gu Netopatita gu Otniel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Rubenitas ka't gu Elieser gu mar gu Sikri; mi' dhɨr gu Simeonitas gu Sepatiias gu mar gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu asabiias gu mar gu Kamuel; gio ba' gu Aaronitas gu Sadok.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Eliuu maa'n gu ja'tkam gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Issakâr gu Omri gu mar gu Mikâel.
Jano' ba' gu Sabuloon gu Ismaiias gu mar gu Abdiias; gio ba' gu Neptalii gu Jerimot gu mar gu Asriel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Oseas gu mar gu Asasiia; gio ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Joel gu mar gu Pedaiia.
Jano' ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Galaad gu Iddo gu mar gu Sakâriias; gio ba' gu Benjamiin gu Jaakiel gu mar gu Abner.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu Asarael gu mar gu Jeroam; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Na gu' cham jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook ka't jix mui' gu Israeel na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia ka't kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' suudai' u'va daak bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' cham ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Asmabet gu mar gu Adiel ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' vaak ja'tkam jɨ'dɨlh taañpu' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Ussiias.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Dabii gu Jerusalem bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel chiñia' bopxi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bopxi'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu maa'nkar gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' kɨkbo gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook tɨɨt; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' dhaibu' tɨɨt chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' ka't tu' bɨx na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham vaak na jix bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaak gu taat na ba' jum duu gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; na gu' gu Judaa gu vaak gu Judaa ja'tkam vaak gu taat; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu taat jix duñia' tu' na ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.
Na gu' bɨx gu ma'nkam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa mui'x gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Salomoon na ba' atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Salomoon gu mar gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu mar tu' jix duñia' gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas tu' tu duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' na ja'p gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jano' vupui bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios maatɨt chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix bhai' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Salomoon gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kutun kavɨk bɨx; mi' dhɨr tu' tu jiim bakia'; gu' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' na ba' gu vaak na ba' xidhuu; gio ba' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix maa gu Salomoon gu mar jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx tu'x ga'ra' aagak na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gio na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix maa jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix uam jodai na ba' bɨx; gio ba' jix toja jodai na ba' bɨx na ba' bɨx.

Jano' ba' jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix uam jodai na ba'; gio ba' jix uam jodai na ba' mɨichdhai; mi' dhɨr na ba' daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix toja jodai na ba' mɨichdhai jurtu'nka' mɨichdhai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa jix uam jodai na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' tɨkiix na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' jix toja jodai na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' gio jix uam jodai na jix bhai' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix uam jodai na ba'; gio ba' na ba' jix toja jodai na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai na jix bhai' na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' jix uam jodai bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' bɨx dhi' tu'x gu Dabii jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu ñi'ook bɨx buimɨi.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; na gu' cham jum i'obh tu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak; jano' ba' cham tu' kiicha' tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas na ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx tu' na ba' no'x na jax chu'm; mi' dhɨr chiñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bɨx bɨx ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu mar tu' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'; na gu' gu vaak cham na ba' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix uam jodai na ba' tu'x jix uam jodai jix toja jodai na ba' tu'x jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam na ba' gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai na ba' jix kavɨk jodai gu u'u na ba' gu u'u gu jodai a'bhar gu jodai jix uam bɨx gu jodai a'bhar gu jodai gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' na gu' no'ñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu' chumñigam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai bɨx tu'x na ba' gu vaak xidhuu jix maa na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maachim vaik jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix uam jodai gu Opir kɨɨv jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix toja jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix uam jodai na ba' tu'x jix uam jodai jix toja jodai na ba' tu'x jix toja jodai na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chɨkka jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bopxi'ñ bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' aagak.

Jano' ba' jix maa na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jixchamaam jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix uam jodai mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix toja jodai jix bhai'x cha'tmam gu jodai' na jix uam jixchamaam jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix kavɨk jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu jodai a'bhar jix maa na ba' chumñigam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jeiel gu Gersonita.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam aagak; na gu' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan bɨx; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel chulhiiñdha' gu taat maa'n.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gɨ'x bhai' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gɨ'x bhai'; na gu' bɨx tu'x gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duñia' bhaan bɨx mo'o.
Jano' ba' namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' vupui bhaan tu' aapi' bɨx; gio ba' gu novɨ bɨxchu'x gu kavɨk gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk bɨx tu'x.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' no'ch tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas na jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' chɨkka jix duñia' tu' chɨkka gu ja'tkam na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aagak tu'x tuutu'm na gu' bɨx dho'ñchidhak gu novɨ tu'.
Na gu' na gu' no'ch gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu'ch vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p bɨx taata'n tattat; gio ba' taata'n gu tanoolh ɨkgiga'n bhaan gu oidha' cham gu Dan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' bɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu novɨ bɨx.

Jano' ba' gu Yo tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kutun kavɨk tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ tu' bɨx dhi' jano' buupui bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu' gaagam jano' tu' jix maa na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Israeel taata'n tattat jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' aagak gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa gu mar gu Salomoon gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk na ba' bɨx tu'x tu' gu vaak na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Dabii bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' bɨx jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' o'lhia vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix bhai'x ali' vaakax jix bhai'x gu chuukug jix bhai'x ali' karneer bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' mui'x makgɨrxi'ñdha' bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' koi'mɨk i'i vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix maa gookim jix duñia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu Dabii gu taat ka't; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bɨx chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel jix maa gɇ'kamtu'nda' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' va'k gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu mar gu Isaii bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel ka't oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kɨɨv jix gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu ñi'ook vaik jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix koi jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jix bhuup gu tanoolh namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Salomoon gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii dharka' u'uan gu Samueel gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Nataan gu Gad gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel bhaan bɨx gu gɨ'kora' mii' dhɨr oi'ñga'n.
